# City of Berkeley

> > Official website for the City of Berkeley, California, providing access to municipal government information, City Council meetings, and public services.

This site serves as the primary digital portal for Berkeley's municipal government, offering residents and stakeholders access to City Council agendas, meeting archives, and information about local governance. The City Council conducts regular and special meetings in various formats including in-person, hybrid, and virtual sessions via Zoom, with broadcasts on Cable B-TV Channel 33.

## Key Topics

- City of Berkeley
- Berkeley City Council
- City Council meetings and agendas
- Public participation and comment
- Zoom videoconferencing
- Granicus meeting platform
- Cable B-TV and Channel 33
- Government Code Section 54953(e)
- Hybrid and remote meetings
- COVID-19 protocols
- Closed sessions
- Special meetings
- Municipal government operations
- Public meeting access
- Meeting archives

## City Council Meeting Archives

- [City Council 2023-05-02](https://berkeleyca.gov/your-government/city-council/city-council-agendas/city-council-2023-05-02): Hybrid City Council meeting agenda from May 2, 2023
- [City Council 2023-03-20](https://berkeleyca.gov/your-government/city-council/city-council-agendas/city-council-2023-03-20): Hybrid City Council special meeting agenda from March 20, 2023
- [City Council 2022-11-28](https://berkeleyca.gov/your-government/city-council/city-council-agendas/city-council-2022-11-28): Virtual City Council meeting agenda from November 28, 2022 via Zoom
- [City Council 2022-09-20](https://berkeleyca.gov/your-government/city-council/city-council-agendas/city-council-2022-09-20-1): Virtual City Council special meeting agenda from September 20, 2022
- [City Council 2022-04-26](https://berkeleyca.gov/your-government/city-council/city-council-agendas/city-council-2022-04-26): Berkeley City Council meeting agenda from April 26, 2022
